scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "uv run --project backend uvicorn research_agent.main:app --reload --port 8000" "uv run --project backend python -m research_agent.worker" "pnpm --dir frontend dev"
scripts.lint: uv run --project backend ruff check backend && pnpm --dir frontend lint
scripts.typecheck: uv run --project backend mypy backend/src && pnpm --dir frontend typecheck
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project backend alembic -c backend/alembic.ini upgrade head
